viewer: Hindi-speaking students and young adults, 15-30, scrolling a feed of dark horror reels
hook: The whole school's shadows are gone at noon. One wet footprint trail crosses the white courtyard.
payoff: For one minute the dead look like the living. Raju took the narrator's hand and the one shadow that returned: the narrator's stayed with Raju, who went home as him.
belief_label: Dadi's rule is an invented family saying, not a sourced regional tradition. Zero Shadow Day itself is a real astronomical event (sun at the zenith at local solar noon, twice a year south of 23.5 N, about one minute).
sources: Original story (Doomsday Horror). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), sound synthesized in code. No third-party footage, images or audio. Science background: https://www.scienceabc.com/eyeopeners/what-is-the-zero-shadow-day.html

story.setup: School courtyard on Zero Shadow Day. Dadi warns: in that minute, whoever's hand you hold takes your shadow. Master ji makes everyone hold hands; the place beside the narrator is Raju's, who drowned last year.

rule_or_clue.text: whoever's hand you hold in that minute takes your shadow
rule_or_clue.line: जिसका हाथ पकड़ोगे, वो तुम्हारी परछाईं ले जाएगा।

rule_or_clue.text: do not hold anyone's hand in that minute
rule_or_clue.line: सुबह रसोई में दादी बोलीं, उस मिनट किसी का हाथ मत पकड़ना।

rule_or_clue.text: the empty place beside him was Raju's, who drowned in the well last year
rule_or_clue.line: मेरे बगल वाली जगह खाली थी। राजू की जगह। पिछले साल वो कुएँ में डूब गया।

escalation.line: बारह बजकर सात मिनट पर, सबकी परछाईं गायब हो गई।
तभी किसी ने मेरा हाथ पकड़ा। चालीस डिग्री में भी, हाथ बर्फ़ जैसा ठंडा था।
मैंने देखा। राजू। गीले बाल, टपकता पानी।

false_relief.text: the minute ends, shadows return, he breathes out
false_relief.line: मिनट पूरा हुआ। सबकी परछाईं लौट आई। मैंने साँस ली।

twist.text: he lets go but his shadow is joined to Raju's feet
twist.line: मैंने हाथ छुड़ाया। पर मेरी परछाईं राजू के पैरों से जुड़ी थी।
twist.how: The hook says one minute a year nobody has a shadow; Dadi's rule says whoever's hand you hold takes your shadow. Raju held his hand in that minute and took it, so Raju goes home as him.

ending_image.text: empty courtyard, the narrator alone with no shadow, hand reaching out toward the lens; wet footprints at his feet

callback.text: now he waits for the minute every year to take someone's hand, as Raju took his
callback.line: अब हर साल, उस एक मिनट में, मैं किसी का हाथ ढूँढता हूँ।

planted_by.line: मेरे बगल वाली जगह खाली थी। राजू की जगह। पिछले साल वो कुएँ में डूब गया।

first_seen.line: मैंने देखा। राजू। गीले बाल, टपकता पानी।

story.scare_pattern: daylight swap: a dead friend takes your hand and your shadow
